questions.question: What choice did Moses set before Israel?
options: Life and good, or death and evil
The hill country or the open plains
War with the nations or peace
questions.answer: Life and good, or death and evil

questions.question: What did Moses urge them to choose?
options: Life, so they and their descendants might live
Death, the path most nations chose
Wealth, to enrich all of the coming generations
Power, to rule over their enemies
questions.answer: Life, so they and their descendants might live

questions.question: Moses said the commandment was not too hard or far off, but near them.
"I have set before you life and death... therefore choose _____."
The word is very near you, in your mouth and in your _____, so you can do it.
